reason: I already use Bitrix24 on a free or cheap plan. It is heavy but my team knows it, and with 7 to 15 people I would need the 199 dollar plan to fit everyone, which is much more than I pay now.
objection: I pay about 15 dollars per user elsewhere and cannot see why a flat price is better. For my team size it would be 199 a month, and there are no customers or references to prove it works.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing another Uzbek company of my size using it, plus a Telegram setup that clearly beats Bitrix24 and a mid-tier price of around 100 dollars for 10 users.
